description: The anchor-clustering stage of MUMmer 3.23 nucmer = `mummer -mum|-mumreference|-maxmatch -b -l L -n | mgaps -l c -s g -d D -f F` (700 related pairs, both strands, all three match modes equal; 758 further mgaps inputs equal): the exact matches (mode 'mum' = maximal unique matches in both sequences, 'mumreference' = unique in the reference, 'maxmatch' = all maximal matches; minMatchLength = -l; only A/C/G/T match) are clustered: matches are sorted by their start in the query, matches inside a repeat are removed and overlapping matches of one diagonal merged, neighbours whose diagonals differ by at most max(diagonalDifference, diagonalFraction * separation) within maxSeparation are joined, and each component is cut into chains of maximum score (match length - overlap - diagonal difference); a chain is reported when its length (sum of the match lengths, or the extent with useExtent) reaches minClusterLength. Coordinates are 1-based as printed by mummer / mgaps; on the reverse strand the query start is a position in the reverse-complemented query; a match's overlap is the number of bases cut off its start because it overlaps the previous match. This is the stage that decides which anchors belong together; the banded extension (postnuc) and delta-filter are not part of this tool. Every option value mgaps accepts is accepted and gives the program's clusters (A4-4, measured on the installed mgaps 3.23: negative or zero separation / cluster length / diagonal difference, NaN, infinite or huge diagonal fraction - the C conversion of the product to long is LONG_MIN, so no fraction is added).

bothStrands.description: Also cluster the reverse-complement strand of the query (nucmer default true).

maxSeparation.description: Largest separation between matches of a cluster (nucmer -g, default 90).

diagonalDifference.description: Fixed diagonal difference that joins matches (nucmer -D, default 5).

diagonalFraction.description: Fraction of the separation added to the allowed diagonal difference (nucmer -d, default 0.12).

useExtent.description: Cluster length = extent in the reference instead of the sum of the match lengths (mgaps -e, default false).

clusters.description: Clusters `{ strand (forward|reverse), matches: [{ start1, start2, length, overlap }] }`, forward strand first, in the order mgaps prints them.

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty

examples.name: Two segments split by a 4 base substitution block
